scorecard.name: Branding and Survey Check
scorecard.coaching: Agent omitted mandatory closing branding 'thank you for choosing s-net' and customer satisfaction survey request.

scorecard.name: Hold time and Dead Air
scorecard.coaching: Agent left two unmanaged silences exceeding 30 seconds (46s at [02:30] and 46s at [06:50]) without hold announcement or thanks.

grader.scenario: Mobile eSIM QR code expired on new iPhone; manual SM-DP+ server address provided and profile installed; agent omits survey and closing branding, and leaves two unmanaged silences > 30s
grader.notes: The agent successfully resolved an expired eSIM activation profile on a new iPhone by provisioning a fresh manual SM-DP+ address and activation code. However, the agent failed Branding and Survey Check by omitting 'thank you for choosing s-net' and the customer satisfaction survey from the closing turns, and failed Hold Time and Dead Air by leaving two unmanaged silences exceeding 30 seconds (46s at [02:30] and 46s at [06:50]) without hold notifications or thanks upon return.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: [12:40] Agent: 'Have a successful court hearing this afternoon and have a good day. Goodbye.' - Closing lacks mandatory S-Net branding and survey mention.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Agent left an unmanaged silence of 46 seconds at [02:30] and another of 46 seconds at [06:50] without announcing hold or thanking customer upon return.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: [01:34] Agent: 'So if I have understood correctly, the original eSIM QR code delivered in your welcome email has expired beyond its forty-eight hour validity window...' - Complete and accurate restatement.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: [07:45] Customer tests 5G data browsing and outbound voice call over eSIM, confirming complete resolution.
